Question: How can PtRu-based high-entropy alloys be synthesized with subnanometer dimensions and tailored morphologies to achieve high activity, stability, and CO resistance for alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction (HOR)?. System: PtRuNiCoFeMo high-entropy alloy subnanometer nanowires (SNWs) with composition Pt/Ru/Ni/Co/Fe/Mo = 29.6/9.3/15.2/15.6/12.2/18.1 (SEM-EDS) or 28.5/6.8/18.6/15.2/10.7/20.2 (ICP-OES).
